tool.name: FADU
tool.description: quantify prokaryotic RNA-Seq expression per GFF3 feature
tool.command: ## Fixed names: FADU derives the index path and output filename from the BAM path. ln -s '${bam}' input.bam && ln -s '${bam.metadata.bam_index}' input.bam.bai && mkdir -p fadu_output && fadu -b 'input.bam' -g '${gff3}' -o 'fadu_output' -s '${stranded}' -f '${feature_type}' -a '${attribute_type}' #if $exclude_regions: -x '${exclude_regions}' #end if ${fragment_handling.keep_only_proper_pairs} #if str($fragment_handling.max_fragment_size) != '' and str($fragment_handling.max_fragment_size) != 'None': -m ${fragment_handling.max_fragment_size} #end if #if str($multimapped.multimapped_selector) == 'remove': -M #else: -e ${multimapped.em_iterations} #end if ${output_options.no_output_header} --log_level '${output_options.log_level}' && mv 'fadu_output/input.counts.txt' '$output_counts'

param.name: bam
param.label: Position-sorted alignments
param.help: Coordinate-sorted BAM file. SAM input is not supported. The BAM index is read automatically.

param.name: gff3
param.label: Annotation
param.help: GFF3 file; GTF is not supported. Feature types and attribute keys are matched exactly (case-sensitive).

param.name: exclude_regions
param.label: Exclude regions
param.help: Optional BED file; alignments overlapping these regions are ignored, e.g. to skip rRNA/tRNA contamination.

param.name: stranded
param.label: Strandedness
param.help: How the read strand relates to the reference strand.

param.name: feature_type
param.label: Feature type
param.help: Only GFF3 records of this type (column 3) are counted. Case-sensitive, e.g. gene or CDS.

validator.message: Feature type must only contain letters, digits, underscores, dots, colons and dashes.

param.name: attribute_type
param.label: Attribute type
param.help: GFF3 attribute key (column 9) used as the feature identifier. Case-sensitive, e.g. ID or locus_tag.

validator.message: Attribute type must only contain letters, digits, underscores, dots, colons and dashes.

param.name: keep_only_proper_pairs
param.label: Keep only proper pairs
param.help: Restrict counting to alignments flagged as properly paired. Fragments exceeding the maximum fragment size are discarded when this is set.

param.name: max_fragment_size
param.label: Maximum fragment size
param.help: Optional; defaults to 1000 when unset. Set to 0 to process every pair as two single reads. With 'keep only proper pairs' set, fragments exceeding this size are discarded.

param.name: multimapped_selector
param.label: Multimapped reads
param.help: How to treat reads aligning to more than one location (NH > 1).

param.name: em_iterations
param.label: EM iterations
param.help: Number of Expectation-Maximization iterations used to fractionally assign multimapped fragments.

param.label: Omit header line
param.help: Write the counts table without the 'featureID uniq_len num_alignments counts tpm' header line.

param.label: Log level
param.help: Verbosity of the log messages written to stderr.

tool.help:
# FADU: Feature Aggregate Depth Utility
FADU quantifies gene (or CDS) expression for **prokaryotic RNA-Seq** from a position-sorted BAM and a GFF3 annotation. Because prokaryotic transcripts are frequently polycistronic (operons), fragments often span several neighbouring features; instead of discarding those fragments, FADU assigns each one **fractional counts proportional to the overlap** between the fragment and the non-overlapping portion of each feature. Single-end reads are weighted half of paired fragments to avoid overcounting.
**Inputs:** position-sorted BAM + GFF3 annotation. SAM input and GTF annotations are not supported, and eukaryotic (splice-aware) data is not supported.
Documentation: https://igs.github.io/FADU/
-----
## Output
A tab-delimited table with one row per feature:
- **featureID** — value of the chosen GFF3 attribute (e.g. `ID` or `locus_tag`) - **uniq_len** — number of non-overlapping bases of the feature - **num_alignments** — number of alignments assigned to the feature - **counts** — fractional count assigned to the feature - **tpm** — transcripts per million, scaled across all features
For downstream differential expression analysis (e.g. DESeq2), extract the `featureID` and `counts` columns, htseq-count style.
-----
## Options
- **Strandedness** — `no` (unstranded), `yes` (read strand matches the feature strand) or `reverse` (read strand is opposite the feature strand). - **Feature type / attribute type** — matched exactly against GFF3 column 3 and the column 9 attribute key, case-sensitive (`gene` and `CDS` are different feature types). - **Exclude regions** — alignments overlapping these BED regions are ignored, e.g. to skip rRNA/tRNA contamination. - **Fragment handling** — *keep only proper pairs* restricts counting to properly paired alignments; the *maximum fragment size* (default 1000) can be set to 0 to process every pair as two single reads. With the proper-pairs filter set, fragments exceeding the maximum fragment size are discarded. - **Multimapped reads** — either removed entirely (reads with `NH` > 1 are dropped), or fractionally assigned with the Expectation-Maximization algorithm using a configurable number of iterations. - **Output options** — omit the header line, and choose the log verbosity.
